issues.problem: Invented Sanskrit. Printed pāṣyo3rabhakta has no avagraha, so "pāṣyaḥ + arabhakta" (which would print pāṣyo3 'rabhakta) is impossible. Regular sandhi: pāṣyoḥ + abhakta gives pāṣyor abhakta (ḥ becomes r after o before a vowel). abhakta is the augmented aorist mid. of √bhaj, not "a-rabhakta" of √rabh. The translation "taken hold" follows the wrong root. Hindi also adds a subject उसने while the English subject is [unclear].

summary: Chunk 2 (993-1030), 38 units. 14 error and 25 minor issues in 29 units; 9 units ok. Manual (no patch): 1012 (na placement), 1017 and 1021 (dharman: dharma vs ordinance). Error classes: droṇa not 'trough' (994); u untranslated (997); noun/verb supplied in one language (998, 1005); ava/ūti not 'help' in Hindi (1002); asyndetic 'and' added (1011); invented split a-rabhakta for pāṣyoḥ abhakta (1014); corrected forms without text_flags (1010 madho, 1015 pṛṣṭeṣu); Ṛgveda/parallel citations in notes (995, 996, 1000, 1005, 1009) and in flag reasons (1004, 1011, 1027, minor). No regrouping suggested. Hindi checked: no Latin letters, brackets or '...'. Still uncertain and left low: 995 apsā, 1006 pṛśanāyuvaḥ, 1013 prāṇā, 1019 gonyoghā, 1014 pāṣyoḥ.
